theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) ∧ T.support = U ∩ R.measure.support) → ∀ (P d n : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid P)) (Z X Y : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (RZ RY : IMRep U n) (proj : Euclid P → Euclid P) (y : Euclid P) (r c ρ t : ℝ), IsOpen U → 0 < n → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 d N → IsMinimizingIn Z (U ∩ N) → Z.support ⊆ N → BoundaryVanishes Z → RZ.Represents Z → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → BoundaryVanishes X → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) (closedBall y t) → X ω = 0) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Y ω = Z ω + X ω) → RY.Represents Y → y ∈ N → 0 ≤ c → 0 < ρ → 3 * ρ < r → 4 * c * ρ ≤ 1 → t < 2 * ρ → closedBall y (3 * ρ) ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 proj (ball y r) → MapsTo proj (ball y r) N → (∀ x ∈ N ∩ ball y r, proj x = x) → (∀ x ∈ N ∩ ball y r, ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace N x, fderiv ℝ proj x v = v) → (∀ x ∈ ball y r, ‖fderiv ℝ proj x‖ ≤ 1 + c * dist x y) → RZ.measure (closedBall y t) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + 3 * c * ρ) ^ n) * RY.measure (closedBall y t) + ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + 3 * c * ρ) ^ n - 1) * RZ.measure (ball y (3 * ρ))
